The `#` in a git ref such as `github:owner/repo#v1.0.0` is not a comment, because no space comes before it:

docs/extensions.md:116:A tool can say how the [workflow log](how-it-works.md#the-workflow-log) shows its calls. Give the tool an optional `present` field. pi-durable does not use it, so other hosts ignore it. pit's `typescript` tool has one (pit 0.36.5 and later): the log shows the label of each program, its code, the functions it uses, and its result as text:
docs/extensions.md:154:pit 0.36.0 and later hide the coding tools from the model themselves. The model gets only pit's `typescript` tool without these inputs, and pit's programs use `workspace.*` and `shell.*` instead of the coding tools (see [Tools the model sees](https://github.com/cv/pit/blob/main/docs/durable.md#tools-the-model-sees) in pit). With an earlier pit, hide the coding tools with `model_tools_hidden`. Its programs can then still call them through `tools.*`:

docs/models.md:16:- uses: cv/pi-action@v2

docs/models.md:96:For Anthropic-compatible endpoints (`provider_api: anthropic-messages`) with Claude Opus 4.6+ or Sonnet 4.6+, set `compat_force_adaptive_thinking: true`.

docs/models.md:126:      @acme/pi-provider@1.4.2

docs/prompts.md:91:- **The log.** The setup group shows the files, for example `Context files: AGENTS.md (2.1 KiB)`.
docs/prompts.md:111:- **The log.** The setup group shows the files, for example `System prompt: .pi/SYSTEM.md (1.2 KiB, replaces pi's base prompt)` and `System prompt: appended agent_dir/APPEND_SYSTEM.md (300 B)`. For a project file that it skips, it writes the reason, for example `System prompt: not loading .pi/SYSTEM.md: trust_project is off`.
